title: ⚠️ Urgent Warning for Developers!
body: Security researchers uncovered malicious copies of Microsoft’s framework for building AI agents, published on the popular Python repository PyPI.
The fake copies carry a name similar to the original and steal login credentials from computers when Python runs — even without importing the library.
Simply put, merely installing the malicious package is enough to steal your cloud keys, so always check the package name before installing, and update to the safe version.
Do you check package names before installing them? And what steps do you take to protect your accounts?
